notes: Use front view for bilateral issues such as asymmetry and elbow flare.
Use side or oblique only for visible-arm ROM, shoulder involvement, torso swing, and tempo when the relevant joints are visible.
Mark an issue unscorable when the camera view, occlusion, or landmark quality prevents a safe judgement.

severity.none: Torso stays mostly upright with no meaningful swing used to move the weight.
severity.mild: Small torso movement appears but does not dominate the rep.
severity.moderate: Clear lean or swing assists the upward phase.
severity.severe: Large body swing or repeated momentum clearly cheats the rep.

severity.mild: Use torso_warn instead unless the swing is clearly excessive.
severity.moderate: Torso movement is large enough to materially assist the curl.
severity.severe: The rep is primarily driven by body momentum.

severity.none: Upper arms stay controlled with elbows mostly pinned.
severity.mild: Small upper-arm drift or shoulder rise.
severity.moderate: Upper arms move noticeably to help finish the rep.
severity.severe: Shoulder heave dominates the top half of the curl.

severity.mild: Use shoulder_warn unless the shoulder involvement is clearly excessive.
severity.moderate: Clear shoulder heave assists the rep.
severity.severe: The rep is completed mostly by shoulder movement rather than elbow flexion.

severity.none: Elbows remain close and stable from the front view.
severity.mild: Small outward flare or drift that remains controlled.
severity.moderate: Clear elbow flare changes the arm path.
severity.severe: Large flare or drift makes the rep materially different from a strict curl.

severity.none: Rep reaches a clear top position.
severity.moderate: Clearly misses the expected top range.
severity.severe: Stops far below the top position.

severity.none: Rep returns to a clear extended bottom position.
severity.moderate: Clearly fails to extend near the bottom.
severity.severe: Uses a very short bottom range or repeated partial pulses.

severity.none: Rep covers full practical curl range.

severity.moderate: Clearly drops or loses control on the way down.
severity.severe: Weight falls rapidly with little eccentric control.

severity.none: Both arms move through similar range and timing.
severity.moderate: Clear difference in height, timing, or range.
severity.severe: One side substantially lags or performs a different rep.
